title: Testing Node.js Applications
description: Master testing techniques for Node.js applications to ensure code quality, reliability, and maintainability. This module covers various types of testing, testing tools, writing effective test cases, and best practices.

lessons.title: Introduction to Testing in Node.js
lessons.content: Learn the importance of testing in software development, different types of tests such as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, and why testing is crucial for Node.js applications.

lessons.title: Setting Up Testing Environment
lessons.content: Understand how to set up a testing environment in Node.js using popular frameworks like Mocha, Jest, and Chai. Learn how to install, configure, and run tests effectively.

lessons.title: Writing Unit Tests
lessons.content: Learn to write unit tests that validate individual functions or modules. Understand test structure, assertions, and how to mock dependencies for isolated testing.

lessons.title: Testing Asynchronous Code
lessons.content: Explore strategies for testing asynchronous functions and promises in Node.js, including callbacks, async/await, and handling timeouts and errors.

lessons.title: Integration Testing
lessons.content: Understand how to test the interaction between multiple modules or services, including testing APIs, databases, and third-party integrations in a Node.js app.

lessons.title: Mocking and Stubbing
lessons.content: Learn how to use mocking and stubbing techniques to simulate external dependencies, isolate test cases, and improve test reliability.

lessons.title: End-to-End Testing with Tools like Cypress
lessons.content: Explore how to write end-to-end tests that simulate real user interactions using tools like Cypress or Selenium, ensuring the entire application flow works as expected.

lessons.title: Test Coverage and Reporting
lessons.content: Understand test coverage metrics, how to measure coverage using tools like Istanbul/NYC, and how to interpret reports to improve your test suites.

lessons.title: Continuous Integration and Automated Testing
lessons.content: Learn how to integrate testing into your development workflow using continuous integration (CI) tools like GitHub Actions, Travis CI, or Jenkins for automated test execution.

lessons.title: Best Practices and Common Pitfalls in Testing
lessons.content: Discover best practices to write maintainable, efficient tests, avoid flaky tests, and common mistakes developers make in Node.js testing.
